notes: The dungeons from the 12 August patch are recognised - Consumed Deus Research Base and Noiran's Hidden Legacy, all 21 of their bosses at every difficulty (Prideful Atiel, Lab Director Zylus, Overseer Gromkas, and Askran, Incomplete Braunt, Mad Klominster across the four Transcendence stages), plus 215 NPCs, 288 skill names and 1,947 buff names added and 97 skill names corrected. Fixes: during the Atiel fight an invisible level 20 helper the boss keeps re-summoning was itself listed as a boss, so every spawn registered as a new boss and threw out the real target - 57 times in a single run - while carrying the real boss's name so nothing showed on screen; a misaligned packet read reporting a boss above its own maximum HP looked like a fresh pull and split one fight into two records, and the maximum is now only re-learned when several readings agree; a party wipe is confirmed against the boss still standing at full health on the next reading instead of the single sample that produced the jump; a death nothing else corroborates no longer counts as a kill, and fights that fail the kill test are logged with the reason instead of vanishing; the compressed bundle sent on entering a zone - which carries your own character, the party roster and the genus, pet and wing lists - can declare a length off by one in either direction and is now recovered by retry instead of discarded; and cached genus, pet and wing data is merged into the fullest known set for a character rather than being overwritten by a partial scan or filed under a session-specific key that never matches again.
